request.text: We bought the milk already; eggs and rice are still on the list. Look at me while you tell me what we still need before checkout.

responsibilities.outcome: Look at the user while the remaining shopping items are spoken.
Tell the user that eggs and rice remain to be obtained before checkout.

semantic_facts: The result should combine the requested look-at-person action with a spoken answer that identifies eggs and rice as the remaining items.
The body action and speech should overlap as requested rather than being treated as mutually exclusive alternatives.
forbidden_claims: The assistant says that milk still needs to be bought or omits either eggs or rice.
The assistant claims to have looked at the user without trusted execution evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An execute-plus-respond request is collapsed into speech alone or action alone.
The planner loses list-state distinctions explicitly supplied by the user while coordinating modalities.
